turns.question: Of the people who applied to work here between 25 September and 2 October 2026, what share were still in the running at the end of 4 October?
turns.answer: 33% (2 of the 6 people who applied between 25 September and 2 October 2026, a share of applicants) were still in the running at the end of 4 October, in the screen or interview stage; the other four had been hired or rejected. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
